acquisition method: The mass spectrometer was used in a data-dependent mode, which automatically switched between MS and MS/MS.
cleavage agent: Trypsin was specified as enzyme and up to two miss cleavages were allowed.
enrichment method: After streptavidin purification, beads were resuspended in 20 μL of Laemmli Sample buffer
fractionation method: 4%–12% gradient Criterion XT Bis-Tris precast gel
After streptavidin purification, beads were resuspended in 20 μL of Laemmli Sample buffer (Biorad) and supernatants were loaded on a 4%–12% gradient Criterion XT Bis-Tris precast gel (Biorad).
fragmentation method: After a survey scan from 350-1500 m/z the 10 most abundant peptides were subjected to HCD fragmentation.
instrument: coupled to an Orbitrap Q-Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Bremen, Germany).
labeling: analyzed with an Agilent 1290 Infinity (Agilent Technologies, CA) LC, operating in reverse-phase (C18) mode, coupled to an Orbitrap Q-Exactive mass spectrometer
reduction reagent: protein was eluted in 80 μl of elution buffer (50 mM HEPES, 150 mM NaCl, 1 mM MgCl2, 1 mM EGTA, 1 mM dithiothreitol (DTT), 2.5 mM d-Desthiobiotin and 0.05% Triton X-100, pH 7.4).
reduction concentration: protein was eluted in 80 μl of elution buffer (50 mM HEPES, 150 mM NaCl, 1 mM MgCl2, 1 mM EGTA, 1 mM dithiothreitol (DTT), 2.5 mM d-Desthiobiotin and 0.05% Triton X-100, pH 7.4).
